tldr: Microsoft Foundry’s browser automation tool is now GA, making managed browser-based agents a production option to evaluate.
The Logic Apps Standard VS Code extension can generate deployment templates and pipeline YAML for Hybrid workflows, reducing bespoke CI/CD work.
DeepSeek says its updated V4.1-Flash completes tasks faster, but the candidate provides no measured speedup.

top.title: Microsoft Foundry browser automation is now generally available
top.summary: Foundry’s managed browser tool is generally available for agents automating tasks across public and private websites, with toolbox integration, Live View, and human control.
top.why: Evaluate it against operating your own browser automation stack, while checking whether its human-control and access boundaries fit your production design.

top.title: VS Code can generate CI/CD assets for Logic Apps Hybrid
top.summary: A Microsoft Tech Community post explains that the Logic Apps Standard VS Code extension can generate the ARM template and Azure DevOps pipeline YAML for Hybrid deployments on Arc-enabled Kubernetes.
top.why: If you run Hybrid workflows, use the generated assets to reduce hand-written deployment plumbing, then review them against your team’s infrastructure and release standards.

top.title: DeepSeek releases an updated V4.1-Flash model
top.summary: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017, a little over five weeks after the original V4.1-Flash, and says the update completes tasks faster; the candidate gives no speedup measurements.
top.why: Treat this as a model to benchmark rather than a proven upgrade, and compare its latency and quality on your own workloads before switching.

also.title: Anthropic gives an outside AI watchdog employee-like access
also.summary: The watchdog can examine Anthropic from the inside and publish its findings without the company’s approval.

also.title: Microsoft reportedly cancels a UK data-center deal with Nscale
also.summary: A report says Microsoft ended an agreement to rent AI infrastructure from Nscale, putting the neocloud operator’s planned IPO at risk.
